pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with relatively smooth edge gradients. Spatial area of individual patches is greatest at the anterior shoulder and decreases toward the posterior rump.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, thick off-white pathways forming a topological network. Junction nodes consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections with consistent pixel thickness across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile formed by short, vertical reddish-brown hairs along the dorsal neck line.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A structural discontinuity is visible in the mane line at the transition point between the lower neck and the shoulder.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, out-of-focus yellow-greenish occlusion is present in the lower central foreground, obscuring a portion of the ventral-lateral pelage.
